diff --git a/src/click/yellow_deprecation.py b/src/click/yellow_deprecation.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..87c3c55
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/click/yellow_deprecation.py
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+from gettext import gettext as _
+
+from .core import Command
+from .core import Context
+from .termui import style
+from .utils import echo
+
+
+class YellowDeprecation(Command):
+    """A :class:`~click.Command` that renders its deprecation warning in
+    yellow instead of red.
+    """
+
+    def invoke(self, ctx: Context) -> t.Any:
+        """Given a context, this invokes the attached callback (if it exists)
+        in the right way.
+        """
+        if self.deprecated:
+            extra_message = (
+                f" {self.deprecated}" if isinstance(self.deprecated, str) else ""
+            )
+            message = _(
+                "DeprecationWarning: The command {name!r} is deprecated.{extra_message}"
+            ).format(name=self.name, extra_message=extra_message)
+            echo(style(message, fg="yellow"), err=True)
+
+        if self.callback is not None:
+            return ctx.invoke(self.callback, **ctx.params)
diff --git a/tests/test_yellow_deprecation.py b/tests/test_yellow_deprecation.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a60a65b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_yellow_deprecation.py
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+import click
+from click.yellow_deprecation import YellowDeprecation
+
+
+def test_yellow_deprecation_warning(runner):
+    @click.command(cls=YellowDeprecation, deprecated="Use other.")
+    def cli():
+        click.echo("ran")
+
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, color=True)
+    assert result.stdout == "ran\n"
+    assert (
+        result.stderr
+        == click.style(
+            "DeprecationWarning: The command 'cli' is deprecated. Use other.",
+            fg="yellow",
+        )
+        + "\n"
+    )
+
+
+def test_yellow_deprecation_not_deprecated(runner):
+    @click.command(cls=YellowDeprecation)
+    def cli():
+        click.echo("ran")
+
+    result = runner.invoke(cli)
+    assert result.stdout == "ran\n"
+    assert result.stderr == ""
